about: The hits scripts/check-no-successor.mjs accepts, and its switch (ops decision D136 item 1, 2026-10-12: nothing public gets a later version until the operator says the network is public). Set "public" to true on that word and the gate passes without scanning. Each entry: the tracked path (or * for another party's name anywhere), the text the hit sits inside (no text = the whole file, name included), and one line saying why it is not a public successor. An entry that covers nothing fails the gate: delete it.
